about_short_description.short_description: Alguna is a modern pricing, quoting and billing platform.

product.name: Alguna Monetization Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing pricing, quoting, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition for AI, SaaS, and fintech companies.

product.name: Pricing & Packaging
product.description: A pricing configuration system for creating and managing subscription, usage-based, transaction-based, tiered, prepaid, one-time, and hybrid pricing models.

product.name: Alguna CPQ
product.description: A configure-price-quote system for creating, approving, and managing customized customer quotes, contracts, and proposals.

product.name: Alguna Billing & Usage Metering
product.description: A billing engine that captures billable events in real time and calculates recurring, usage-based, overage, and hybrid charges without requiring custom billing code.

product.name: Alguna Invoicing & Accounts Receivable
product.description: An accounts receivable and payment collection system for generating invoices, tracking outstanding balances, automating dunning, and reconciling payments.

product.name: Alguna Revenue Recognition
product.description: An automated revenue recognition system for allocating contract revenue, tracking performance obligations, generating journal entries, and supporting ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance.
